Each step uses `box.style.setProperty()` which sets inline styles (higher specificity than CSS rules). The JavaScript applies: 1. First step: green theme 2. Second step: orange theme 3. Third step: blue theme Since the third step is applied last and uses inline styles, its values will override the CSS values. But wait - the third step doesn't set ALL properties. Each step sets properties on `box.style`. So after step 2, `--shadow-final` and `--border-color-final` are set inline. Step 3 doesn't touch them, so they remain from step 2.
